cited.quote: Creation of Women Entrepreneurship by providing 5 goats/sheep

rationale: No extract shows an interest-free Rs 50,000 loan to BPL women for cottage industries. C4 is a GO for free goats/sheep to widows and destitute women, a different benefit. C1 describes SHG credit guarantee and interest subvention, a different scheme. Only related activity is shown.

cited.quote: From Tindivanam to Kanyakumari, it has been insisted to take up the work.

rationale: C2 only says the state has insisted on the work, an undated statement with no Assembly resolution, letter or GO. C1 reports NHAI preparing DPRs and an in-principle alignment approval by GoTN, which is not a formal step urging the Centre to approve the six-lane project.

cited.quote: Koyambedu to Avadi - Sanction of Rs.4,80,00,000/- accorded

rationale: The extracts concern Chennai Metro extensions, including a DPR sanction for Koyambedu to Avadi (C1). None shows a broad gauge railway track on the Avadi-Thiruperumpathur-Guduvanchery route. Metro DPR work is a different project, so only related activity is shown.

cited.quote: Develop tourist destinations/ attractions in a planned manner

rationale: Directional commitment. C3 is a GO dated 2021-11-03 approving guidelines for a Tourism Destination Development Scheme to develop quality infrastructure at tourist destinations, a dedicated new scheme on the promise's subject. C1 shows earlier works at Courtallam and Mamallapuram sanctioned in 2020-21, before this government.

cited.quote: Conversion of existing street lights into energy efficient LED lights

rationale: No extract shows LED bulbs issued at subsidised prices to ration card holders. C1 to C3 list subsidised items for card holders without LED bulbs. C4 and C5 are loans for LED street lights in urban bodies, a different object and beneficiary.

cited.quote: launched the Sanitary Workers’ Empowerment Scheme on 09.12.2022 at Madurai

rationale: Directional commitment. C1 reports a dedicated scheme for sanitary workers in urban local bodies, launched on 09.12.2022, with health insurance, safety equipment and skill training. C2 reports an ID card and welfare board registration under the same scheme.

cited.quote: Establishment of Diabetic Foot Clinic in 21 Government Medical College Hospitals

rationale: The promise is a dedicated diabetes and blood pressure wing in every government hospital. C5 sanctions diabetic foot clinics in 21 medical college hospitals, and C4 describes screening and a pilot foot clinic. These are narrower and different. C2 and C3 are COVID protocols. No dedicated wing in every hospital is shown.

cited.quote: providing subsidy assistance to purchase 5 Tractors with trailers, 5 Seedling planting machinery, 5 Harvesting machinery

rationale: Directional commitment. C4 is a GO dated 2021-11-20 sanctioning funds under the mechanization sub mission, including subsidy for cooperative societies to buy harvesting machinery. C3 is a later GO with machinery hire subsidy. C1, C2 and C5 are budget speeches, which do not count. Some doubt whether the sub mission is new.

cited.quote: Two ESIC Hospitals at Tirunelveli, Tiruppur and ESI Medical College Hospital at

rationale: The promise is to urge the Centre to set up ESI hospitals in Tiruppur and Erode. No extract shows a letter, resolution or GO urging the Union. C3 only lists existing ESI facilities, including an ESIC hospital at Tiruppur, with none at Erode. C4 and C5 are about Coimbatore.

cited.quote: the Government hereby constitute the Fifth Police Commission with the following composition
The Government will take appropriate action after considering the recommendations

rationale: C1 is the GO of 2022-02-16 constituting the Fifth Police Commission, which fulfils the first part. C2 says only an interim report was submitted and the government will act later. C3 shows repeated tenure extensions. No implementation of recommendations is shown, so the status is partial.

The promise is new bus stations and accommodation at eleven named pilgrim and tourist places. C1 to C3 only describe bus services to such places. C4 is a planning-area notification for Tiruthani and C5 is a rural bus-stand facilities scheme. No new bus station or accommodation at the named places is shown.

cited.quote: Further this Commissionerate was renamed as the “Commissionerate of Welfare of Non-Resident Tamils and Rehabilitation Department” in the year 2021

rationale: C2 shows that in 2021 the existing Commissionerate was renamed to cover Non-Resident Tamils welfare and placed under a minister for that subject, rather than a new department being created. C1 and C3 show a welfare board still being set up. Reduced scope, hence diluted; date is year-only and doubtful.

cited.quote: It has been proposed to form a new canal for a total length of 262.19 km

rationale: The promise is to urge the Union government to start interlinking of South Indian rivers. The extracts show only the state's own intra-state link canal projects and investigation GOs. No letter, resolution or other formal step urging the Centre is shown.

cited.quote: Hence Government of Tamil Nadu will continuously urge the Government of India

rationale: C1, C2 and C3 are policy notes stating that the government will urge or urges the Union to amend the Constitution on reservation quantum. These are statements of intent. No Assembly resolution, letter or GO on this issue is shown. C4 and C5 concern a state internal reservation roster.

cited.quote: replacing the old, outdated windmills owned by Private Wind power Developers in Tamil Nadu

rationale: C2 is a GO dated 2024-08-22 approving the Tamil Nadu Repowering, Refurbishment and Life Extension Policy for Wind Power Projects, to replace old windmills of private developers with new ones. This matches the promise of removing old windmills and permitting new ones.

Indicator asks for institutional mechanisms to execute the diversified industrial growth policy. The extracts show policies (Industrial Policy 2021, Logistics Policy, Startup Policy) and long-standing bodies such as Guidance, but no new institution established for this purpose. A policy alone is not an institutional mechanism.

None of the extracts concerns the farm laws passed by the previous government or their repeal. C1 is about repeal of animal disease Acts, C2 and C4 are food and nutrition security funding GOs, C3 is about criminal laws, and C5 is a registration department note.

cited.quote: MINES AND MINERALS POLICY NOTE 2023 - 2024 DEMAND No. 27 DURAIMURUGAN MINISTER FOR WATER RESOURCES

rationale: C1 and C2 show mines and minerals still handled within the Industries department, with the policy note presented by the Minister for Water Resources. C3 describes a Directorate formed in 1983. No new Ministry for Mines and Minerals is shown. C4 and C5 are routine lease GOs.

No extract shows cooperative societies being created with 12th standard educated rural women as members. C2 describes existing tailoring cooperatives for women below poverty line aged 18 to 40. C4 and C5 concern newly formed labour and skill societies for sanitary workers. Only related activity is shown.

No extract concerns opposing genetically modified technology or experiments. C1 and C2 establish genetic disorder labs in hospitals, C3 covers seed genetic purity testing, C4 is about the Mekedatu dam dispute, and C5 is about livestock breeding schemes.
